review_candidates.description: Company Description SARACA is a global engineering R&D services company partnering with more than 25 Fortune 500 customers across MedTech, Aerospace, Rail, Automotive, Semiconductor, Defense, and Farm industries. The company is ISO 13485 certified and has extensive experience in designing and developing next-generation medical devices, including embedded software, UI/UX, mechanical systems, and product testing. SARACA’s leadership team brings deep product engineering expertise, supported by a technically strong team of 400+ engineers and management consultants delivering solutions to onsite and offsite projects worldwide. With a global presence, SARACA focuses on solving complex business problems for customers and driving faster growth in their respective industries. SARACA is an equal-opportunity employer that promotes a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and inclusive success. Role: NOC Engineer – Telecom / Network Operations Location: Louisville, KY or Austin, TX – Onsite Start Date: Immediate Availability Background Check: Mandatory Job Summary We are looking for a NOC Engineer to support a 24x7 Network Operations Center responsible for real-time monitoring, incident detection, alarm triage, initial troubleshooting, escalation, and service restoration across large-scale telecom and network service environments. The ideal candidate will have experience in telecom, ISP, broadband, cable, or service-provider network operations , with strong knowledge of network monitoring, incident management, and troubleshooting. Key Responsibilities Monitor network, service, application, and infrastructure platforms in real time. Detect, acknowledge, correlate, and prioritize alarms and service-impacting events. Perform initial troubleshooting and impact assessment for broadband, access, core, IP, voice, video, Wi-Fi, mobile, and enterprise services. Troubleshoot issues involving routing, switching, CMTS, HFC, DOCSIS, security, applications, and load-balancing environments . Create, update, and maintain detailed incident and trouble tickets. Coordinate P1/P2 and major incidents , including bridge initiation, technical updates, escalation, and restoration tracking. Escalate incidents to network engineering, field operations, vendors, application teams, leadership, and other resolver groups. Follow established SOPs, runbooks, incident workflows, and ITIL-aligned processes . Ensure timely incident acknowledgment, escalation, communication, and resolution in accordance with SLAs. Support root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, operational reporting, and continuous improvement. Maintain effective communication during critical incidents and shift handoffs. Ensure accurate documentation throughout the incident lifecycle. Required / Preferred Skills Experience working in a NOC / Network Operations environment . Background in telecom, ISP, cable, broadband, or service-provider networks . Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting . Experience with DOCSIS, CMTS, HFC, or broadband networks is highly preferred. Experience with network monitoring, alarm management, event correlation, and fault isolation. Hands-on experience handling P1/P2 incidents or major network outages . Strong incident management, escalation, and service restoration experience. Knowledge of ITIL, SOPs, runbooks, ticketing systems, and SLA management . Strong communication and documentation skills. Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 NOC/shift-based environment . Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate will have a strong telecom/ISP/cable NOC background with hands-on experience in network monitoring, alarm triage, troubleshooting, incident escalation, and service restoration. Candidates with DOCSIS/CMTS/HFC and IP networking experience are especially relevant. If you are interested in this opportunity, please share your updated resume, current location, and availability for consideration.

review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Channel Sales
review_candidates.description: Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. Who We Are In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Summary In this role, you will lead and transform our channel sales organization in the Alps region (Switzerland and Austria) to align with Palo Alto Networks’ vision: securing the digital enterprise via integrated, platform-led cybersecurity spanning Zero Trust Network Security (Strata), Cloud Security and AI-driven Security Operations (Cortex) as well as Identity Security (Idira). You will be a member of our sales leadership team, managing a high-performing team of Channel Business Managers (CBMs) to accelerate bookings, expand recurring cloud/SaaS revenue, and scale our Next-Wave partner ecosystem (MSSPs, GSIs, Cloud Service Providers, and Specialized Security Partners). You thrive in high-growth, highly collaborative environments and possess the executive presence required to engage top-tier partner C-suites across Zurich, Vienna, and beyond. Key Responsibilities Drive Ecosystem Growth & Revenue Outcomes: Own the regional channel quota across Switzerland and Austria. Drive net-new customer acquisition and expansion through platform-led co-selling across Strata, Cortex, Idira. Modernize Partner Capabilities: Shift partner models from traditional transactional reselling to high-margin managed security services (MSSP), cloud consulting, and specialized SOC transformations leveraging Palo Alto Networks platforms. Lead & Empower High-Performing Teams: Coach, mentor, and develop a regional team of CBMs, fostering an inclusive, accountable, and high-energy culture focused on value-based selling and career growth. Strategic Ecosystem Alignment: Build strong joint go-to-market (GTM) business plans with key regional partners, Global System Integrators (GSIs), Hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and strategic distributors in the Alps market. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Enterprise District Sales Managers, Commercial Leads, Systems Engineering, and Field Marketing to execute unified account strategies and seamless co-sell motions. Data-Driven Execution & Forecasting: Drive operational excellence with accurate weekly/monthly pipeline forecasting, partner-led deal tracking, and telemetry-backed channel performance metrics. Market Presence & Executive Engagement: Serve as the executive voice of Palo Alto Networks within the Alps partner community, representing the brand at industry events, partner roundtables, and high-stakes deal negotiations. Qualifications People Leadership: 5+ years of direct sales management experience leading channel, ecosystem, or enterprise sales teams with a proven track record of hiring, coaching, and retaining top-tier talent. Cybersecurity/SaaS Expertise: Deep understanding of modern cybersecurity domains (Zero Trust, SASE, Cloud Native Security, SecOps, PAM/IAM) and consumption models (SaaS, Managed Services, Enterprise Agreements). Alps Market Knowledge: Demonstrated understanding of the business culture, compliance landscapes, and enterprise IT ecosystem in Switzerland and Austria. Strong existing C-level relationships across regional partners, GSIs, and MSSPs. Strategic Partner Motion: Proven ability to drive complex co-sell and ecosystem strategies, specifically aligning with Cloud Hyperscalers, MSSPs, and System Integrators. Strategic & Hands-On Execution: A balanced "player-coach" mindset, capable of driving high-level strategy with regional executive teams while stepping in to help close complex strategic partner deals. Languages: Business-fluent German and English (written and spoken) are required; French capability is a strong advantage for the Swiss market. Travel: Willingness to travel up to 40% across Switzerland, Austria, and regional European headquarters. Our Commitment We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

review_candidates.description: Overview TISTA Science and Technology is seeking a System Maintenance Technician II to join our growing team. At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do. TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Professional development reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more! Responsibilities SolarWinds, ScienceLogic, Splunk, SNMP, or equivalent monitoring training – Desired for interpreting infrastructure alerts, system-health conditions, and performance anomalies.\ Data-center operations and server-room safety training – Desired for rack-and-stack activities, power and cabling work, physical inspections, equipment handling, and controlled data-center operations. Hardware break/fix and field-replaceable-unit training – Desired hands-on experience replacing memory, CPUs, disk drives, motherboards, expansion cards, and power supplies, followed by successful server restart and health validation. Linux/Unix server-maintenance command proficiency – Required practical skill in checking filesystem capacity, identifying large/old/duplicate files, calculating directory sizes, and performing other maintenance diagnostics. Monitoring and maintenance tool familiarity – Desired experience with tools identified in the maintenance requirements, including BigFix, SNMP, GitHub, SolarWinds, Splunk, QRadar, EnCase, ScienceLogic, Puppet, IPMI, iLO, and iDRAC. Preventive and emergent maintenance planning – Ability to schedule routine maintenance without disrupting normal workflow, recognize emergent maintenance needs, select an appropriate response, and maintain accurate maintenance logs. Vendor maintenance coordination training/experience – Desired experience coordinating field-engineer visits, validating systems after warranty maintenance, and updating associated tickets. Qualifications RAID and enterprise storage training – Desired for disk health monitoring, RAID troubleshooting, disk replacement, SMART status validation, and storage integrity. Red Hat Satellite training – Desired for Linux infrastructure inventory, patch-level verification, and system lifecycle support. BigFix training – Desired for patch-status validation, endpoint compliance, and infrastructure maintenance activities. Ansible and Puppet familiarity/training – Desired for configuration-management awareness, automation support, and validation of server-management agents. ServiceNow and CMDB training – Desired for incident, maintenance, asset, configuration, and work-record documentation. Desired Qualifications CompTIA Server+ – Desired for enterprise server hardware installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, storage, and lifecycle support. CompTIA A+ – Desired for foundational hardware diagnostics, component replacement, peripheral support, and troubleshooting. CompTIA Linux+ or equivalent Linux administration training – Desired for Linux command-line maintenance, filesystem analysis, storage utilization, and basic OS troubleshooting. Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Linux administration training – Desired for RHEL system maintenance, storage, filesystems, services, and troubleshooting. Oracle Solaris Administration training or certification – Desired for Solaris server maintenance, zpools, and Unix infrastructure support. Dell, HPE, Oracle, or equivalent enterprise server hardware training – Desired for hardware diagnostics, firmware maintenance, component replacement, and vendor-specific server management. iDRAC, iLO, IPMI, or equivalent out-of-band management training – Desired for remote hardware monitoring, diagnostics, power management, and recovery. Education AA or two year technical school degree and 3+ years’ work experience Four (4) years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education (7 years total) Clearance The ability to pass a Tier 2/Moderate Background Investigation Location: Department of Veteran's Affairs (100% On-site) Monday - Friday (8:00 AM - 4:30 PM EST Time) Philadelphia Information Technology Center (PITC) VA-PITC, 5000 Wissahickon Ave. Philadelphia, PA 19144
